intent.proves: Every stock unit entry with a location points at an existing stock location.
intent.scope: all EcomStockUnit rows with a location; complete enumeration

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(s.Id AS nvarchar(50)) + N' -> ' + CAST(s.StockUnitStockLocationId AS nvarchar(50)) FROM EcomStockUnit s WHERE ISNULL(s.StockUnitStockLocationId, 0) <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomStockLocation l WHERE l.StockLocationId = s.StockUnitStockLocationId)
